reply: For tracking protein concentration in a whey stream that can vary in turbidity, Near-Infrared (NIR) spectroscopy is a promising primary method due to its effectiveness in aqueous environments and ability to handle varying optical densities. Fluorescence spectroscopy could complement NIR if high sensitivity is needed, especially under turbid conditions. Initial lab trials should establish the calibration model using representative samples across expected turbidity levels.
